title: problems with custom menu in rpg maker mz

posts.author: lucasvidaloka
posts.body: I'm trying to create a custom menu through events and for some reason I don't know, every time I activate the menu the last button appears on the top left side of the screen... how to fix it?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
That's where you're telling it to be?
0, 0 is the top left corner of the screen.
Without some more information like seeing the actual picture file, it looks like it's doing exactly what it should.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
it has all buttons there based on your setup, but your setup as it is
isn't really smart, I made an evented menu that is 1 way,
there is also a blog on how to build one, or a different scene.
just parallel how it is has no trigger for arrow presses, neither to lock
the player movement and all as they can still roam around, even if
you click on the image by mouse.
you should make things better or read the tutorial to extend it further

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
That's a good point - as written, your event is constantly erasing/drawing pictures 60 times a second, which is a waste of computer resources (and serves no point).
This is the tutorial
@ShadowDragon
mentioned.
Eventing a Picture-Based Menu | The Official RPG Maker Blog
The default RPG Maker menu works well, but sometimes you want one that fits your game’s aesthetic better or offers only the important options. Eventing your own picture-based menu is a great way to make sure your menu fits your game, so let’s take a look at how to make one.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
